name: Angola Current

regional_observed_period.scope: Mooring array near 11 S; month precision retained, not whole-current coverage

source_evidence.citation: Kopte et al. (2017), The Angola Current: Flow and hydrographic characteristics as observed at 11 S, doi:10.1002/2016JC012374.
source_evidence.supports: Regional moored velocities during July 2013–October 2015 support mean southward flow and reversals. The 15–90 km offshore box at 30–200 m is a mean-flow-based transport integration domain, not a seasonal physical width.

source_evidence.citation: Korner, Brandt and Dengler (2023), Seasonal cycle of sea surface temperature in the tropical Angolan Upwelling System, doi:10.5194/os-19-121-2023.
source_evidence.supports: Names the slope/shelf current and its encounter with Benguela Coastal Current. The 6 S ecosystem boundary and 15–18 S frontal region are contextual geography, not full-current measured endpoints.

source_evidence.citation: Kopte et al. (2017), The Angola Current - flow and hydrographic characteristics as observed at 11 S, PANGAEA dataset publication series.
source_evidence.locator: License, coverage and eight child datasets.
source_evidence.supports: CC-BY-3.0 data acquisition lead for local velocity and hydrography; aggregate bounds include other cruise coverage and must not define a current footprint. No sample data acquired.

rejected_inferences.inference: 90 minus 15 km transport-domain span used as physical or seasonal width
rejected_inferences.reason: Source selects a fixed domain based on reconstructed mean flow, without dated width-edge diagnostics.

rejected_inferences.inference: 6 S ecosystem boundary to 15–18 S frontal zone as measured whole-current endpoints
rejected_inferences.reason: Ecosystem geography and thermal frontal positions do not establish a velocity axis and termination at a declared depth/time.

rejected_inferences.inference: PANGAEA collection bounding box as current footprint
rejected_inferences.reason: Collection includes multiple cruises and observational variables.

remaining_gates: Review identity admission and regional aliases against current, undercurrent, gyre and frontal-zone names.
Choose a stated layer and time support before tracing northern feeding and southern termination; do not use ecosystem bounds as measured endpoints.
Diagnose cross-stream boundaries from dated velocity data; keep fixed transport integration domains separate from physical width.
Acquire and pin relevant PANGAEA child data before creating dated sections or seasonal animations.
Integrate reviewed identity, sources, taxonomy, OSW state joins and NASA navigation in a versioned inventory update.
